title: Relics page: vaulted tag wrong for Nyx Prime
body:
### What happened

Nyx Prime shows as farmable but its relics are vaulted.

See [the wiki page](https://wiki.warframe.com/w/Nyx_Prime) and this screenshot:

![screenshot](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1/abc.png)

### Technical details

```text
orbiter 0.1.0 (a1b2c3d) on linux x86_64
[2026-11-04][10:00:00][app][INFO] build a1b2c3d
```
